title: Stuck order: move
description: The move step of resolving a stuck order: another actor, compared at the accountable party, moves the value the decision named (REQ-AUZ-4, ADR-0011). Policy answers with a decision.

request.description: The request's id, which its answer names.

carries_out.description: The decide step's decision it carries out.
